notes.title: Delivery Days is out now!
notes.content:
[h2]Delivery Days[/h2][p align="start"]Sometimes the simplest encounters can change everything.[/p][p align="start"]In Delivery Days, a visual novel about chance meetings and unexpected bonds, you play as an overworked man who begins to find warmth and connection through the people who step into his life—one knock at the door at a time.[/p][p align="start"]Order food, request help, or simply open the door—and you might find more than you expected waiting on the other side.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970456/6d95370c2ee8e76f6c19b197c6ce9645a1bc3c09.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3860730/Delivery_Days/?beta=1"][/dynamiclink]
[b]Features[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]A modern-day romance visual novel with multiple branching routes.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Experience different stories depending on who you open your heart to.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Slice-of-life warmth mixed with emotional twists.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Choices that determine your relationships and endings.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Will you keep things casual, or let your heart get carried away with every delivery?

[/b][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Join the our community on [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FFXb6Gq5M4e&snr=1_5_9_"]Discord[/url], connect with other players, share your ideas, and become part of growing community.[/p]
